verdict.rationale: Docs show every UCP-enabled storefront automatically exposes a /api/ucp/mcp endpoint and a merchant publishes a UCP profile at {shop}.myshopify.com/.well-known/ucp for capability negotiation — that's a documented, quasi-self-serve publishing path, and probes confirm live merchant endpoints exist. But the pack explicitly contradicts full self-serve: order webhook subscription is 'not self-serve... contact your Shopify partner manager,' and there is no merchant-facing admin setting or signed agreement flow described (all guidance is developer/CLI-facing, not merchant-console-facing). missing for 10: a merchant-admin toggle/setting in Shopify admin UI, an explicit merchant agreement/terms step, and self-serve webhook registration (currently manual via partner manager).
